The 'fishblicc' package.

Source: R/fishblicc-package.R
fishblicc-package.Rd

Procedures to fit catch curves to length frequency data based using length intervals.

Details

The package supports fitting a Bayesian length interval catch curve, with selectivity modelled as an optional mixture of logistic and normal functions. The package is designed to be used with multiple gears with different selectivities fishing the same stock.
